correctness.rationale: The cyclic unit group order 2047=23*89 makes the nonprimitive set precisely mu23 union mu89. Independently evaluated all four explicit GF(2)[T] carryless Bezout polynomial identities for (r,s)∈{23,89}²: each U(T)(T^r+1)+V(T)((T+1)^s+1)=1 exactly; hence no common root in any extension. Separately constructed F_2048 via x^11+x^2+1 and exhausted nonzero elements: exactly 111 nonprimitive, zero consecutive pairs. Composite m<11 have proper subfields with nontrivial x and x+1 of lower order; prime m<11 give Mersenne prime 3,7,31,127. Euler phi gives 1936/2047 and the threshold implication follows by counterexample, not extrapolation.
